content.short: Swiss non-custodial ramp for buying and selling crypto straight from your bank to your wallet.
content.description: DFX, based in Zug and supervised under the VQF self-regulatory body, moves money between bank accounts and the user's own wallet without ever holding the coins. Users connect MetaMask, Ledger or Trezor, send EUR or CHF by SEPA, and receive one of more than 80 cryptocurrencies directly. It has processed over $100 million for 30,000 customers, and people can already pay with crypto through DFX in 137 SPAR stores.
content.meta: Buy and sell 80+ cryptocurrencies bank-to-wallet via SEPA with DFX, a regulated Swiss ramp that never holds your coins.
